summary: Phase 07 frontend E2E (desktop 1920 + mobile 390) on the preview URL using API-seeded TEST7UI_ data (2 vendors, 1 product each, TEST7UI Flat shipping $5, 2 buyers). I completed a REAL Stripe hosted checkout with the 4242 card: draft $70 -> checkout.stripe.com -> returned to /checkout/payment/:id -> 'Payment confirmed'. The real Stripe webhook (confirmed_by=webhook) marked the order paid. Fee 233 was split 166/67 across the vendors and sums exactly. Commission is 10% of items only (450/150). Also verified: save for later (guest and signed-in, kept after reload, saved section shown when the cart is empty), cancel/retry, account orders/receipt, the order permission check, vendor earnings with a SIMULATED payout account, admin payments (reconciliation, hold days, adding/removing a category rule with history, validation errors, placing/releasing a hold, a real Stripe refund, the over-refund guard, an empty disputes tab, releasing a SIMULATED transfer once (idempotent), simulated bank payout) and no horizontal overflow at 390px. All core flows passed. Found 2 small logic/UX bugs, 1 mobile layout bug and some stale copy. All test data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: net_minor is the remaining ledger balance for the vendor order (vendor_payments.py line ~110: bal.get(v['_id'],0)), not the vendor's net earning. After a transfer or payout the 'Your net' column drops from $43.84 to $0.00. Expose a separate earned_net_minor (items+shipping-commission-fee-refunds) and keep remaining balance as its own field.
An out-of-range rate (150%) returns raw Pydantic text 'Input should be less than or equal to 5000' (in bps). The admin entered a %, so the message should say 'Rate must be between 0% and 50%'.

ui_bugs.issue: Only the order-number text is a Link. Clicking anywhere else on the row (date/status/total) does nothing, which users won't expect. Make the whole <li> a link.
Tone is 'gold' only for pending_payment and 'success' for everything else, so draft/cancelled/expired orders would show a green badge.

The tabs wrap onto 2 lines but the TabsList keeps a fixed height, so the second row (Orders & refunds / Disputes / Payouts) overflows the pill background and overlaps the top of the card below. Use h-auto with flex-wrap, or make the tabs scroll horizontally (overflow-x-auto, no wrap).

'Issue refund' stays enabled when 0 items are refundable. The backend rejects it correctly ('Only 0 of ... can still be refunded'), but the button or Refund toggle should be disabled when nothing is refundable.

issues: The 'Order earnings' card has no left padding on mobile: the heading and the table start flush with the card border, while the Transfers card has padding. The table does scroll inside its container (no page overflow).
The top preview banner still says 'Payment opens in a later phase.' and the PDP note (pdp-cart-note) says 'Payment opens in Phase 07.' Payments are live in test mode now, so update this copy.
Cart heading shows '(1 items)'. Pluralize it.

Right above 'Pay $70.00 securely', the copy says 'you won't be charged at this step', and tax shows 'Not yet calculated' on the final pay step. This is confusing: show the final tax ($0.00) and drop the 'won't be charged' line on the draft page.

action_items: Fix the AdminPaymentsPage TabsList wrap/overlap on mobile (h-auto or horizontal scroll)
Return an earned net value in the vendor earnings API so 'Your net' doesn't show $0.00 after payout (keep remaining balance separate)
Show a human-readable % range error for out-of-range commission rates
Make the whole account order row clickable and fix the badge tone for non-paid statuses
Add mobile padding to the Order earnings card
Update stale 'Payment opens in a later phase / Phase 07' copy (preview banner and PDP note), the '(1 items)' plural and the draft-page 'won't be charged' text
Disable the refund submit/toggle when 0 items are refundable
critical_code_review_comments: vendor_payments.py: net_minor overloads the remaining balance (see above).
AdminPaymentsPage Settings: hold-days save doesn't validate the input client-side (Number('') -> 0) and doesn't re-fetch config. The commission rule form isn't reset after saving.
UI-created commission rules have note='' (no note field in the form), so audit/cleanup by note isn't possible. Consider an optional note input.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; 1 medium mobile layout bug, rest minor)

test_credentials: Super admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md worked. Test users were created at runtime and deleted.
seed_data_creation: Seeded via API and fully cleaned. Removed: 4 TEST7UI_ users, 2 vendors/stores, 2 products, orders, payments, vendor_orders, order_items, refund, ledger, payout, connected_accounts, carts, addresses, the TEST7UI Flat shipping method, the UI-created Fashion 15% rule, the 10 real Stripe webhook_events from this run and the audit_logs since 16:40. Final DB: users=1 (super admin), commission_rules=1 (default 10%), all payment collections are 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Stripe hosted checkout CAN be automated: click [data-testid=card-accordion-item-button] (or input[value=card]), fill #cardNumber/#cardExpiry/#cardCvc/#billingName/#billingPostalCode, then click [data-testid=hosted-payment-submit-button]. The real webhook arrives within ~5s and the status page shows payment-confirmed. To test payouts, set vendor_orders.eligible_at in the past via Mongo, then use admin-pay-release-all. Not tested: a real dispute via the UI (no dispute was created; would need the dispute test card 4000000000000259) and vendor dispute evidence submission.
rca of the issue: Admin tabs overlap: the shadcn TabsList has a fixed h-9/h-10, and with flex-wrap the extra row renders outside it. Vendor net shows $0.00: the API maps net_minor to the ledger balance by vendor_order_id, which reaches 0 after the transfer ledger entry.
